findings.text: LEFT is free of Open the lid 5.2 s before its end: it moves to its next task's start and starts its part of the next stage meanwhile, the RIGHT arm finishing the task; the collision check covers both arms over it.

RIGHT row 9, program 56: the controller first moves the arm 1 deg to the program's first point, at its Start % (30 %): that move takes 0.4-0.5 s on the robot, which widens this arm's timing from here.

LEFT is free of Open the seat 6.5 s before its end: it moves to its next task's start and starts its part of the next stage meanwhile, the RIGHT arm finishing the task; the collision check covers both arms over it.
The lid and seat tasks are ALIX's plans, made with the UGV at 250 mm from the commode and no offset: place the UGV there for them (Lite cannot see the placement).

Open the lid (38.5-71.2 s) is ALIX's plan: its hands hold the lid and the seat by design, so it is left out of this collision check (ALIX's planner checked it with the commode's contact allowances); its camera checks are assumed here, and asked of the camera in Real. Each arm's move to its next task's start after it (71.2-74.0 s) is Lite's own, checked here.

Open the seat (102.7-133.8 s) is ALIX's plan: its hands hold the lid and the seat by design, so it is left out of this collision check (ALIX's planner checked it with the commode's contact allowances); its camera checks are assumed here, and asked of the camera in Real. Each arm's move to its next task's start after it (133.8-137.6 s) is Lite's own, checked here.
